lessons.title: Interval for Two Proportions

lessons.title: Hypothesis Test for Two Proportions
lessons.intro: Write H0 equality/difference zero and directed or two-sided Ha with contextual parameters. Compute pooled p-hat as combined successes/combined n and explain null-world pooling.

lessons.title: Chi-Square Test for Homogeneity
lessons.intro: Recognize comparing categorical distributions across independent samples/treatment groups. Write distribution-equality homogeneity hypotheses.

lessons.title: Chi-Square Test for Independence
